ns2:section.sectionText: Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer. Students who have completed MDIA 320 Sales Management (SP 66003 FA 66560) should not register for ADV 320. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. ADV 270 is *not* required for this course. For questions, please contact the instructor at dclifton@illinois.edu. This course is taught asynchronously.
